messages:
keisha: FYI I brought up the Orion LoRA merge for cust-orion yesterday and ran the 60-sample quickpack on q5_1 (experimental 5-bit per-channel). Seeing concise/abrupt answers on multi-step reasoning prompts for ~5 samples. not huge but customer noticed.
tao: can you paste the sample ids and the eval command?
keisha: samples: 7, 22, 45 — examples show early EOS or repetition after a comma. run was: ./eval/run_quickpack.sh --model orion-lora-custmerge:q5_1 --promptset cust-orion-60 --seed 11 --batch 6 --max-tokens 180
priya: batch=6 + q5_1 might be pushing the runtime kernel path into the fallback that clips sequences. try batch=1 and --disable-prefix-cache to rule out cache duplication.
dave: also what tokenizer/version was used? cust-orion uses vocab-patch v5 which shifts a couple special token ids. if remap was applied post-merge that could misalign small prompt encoders in the adapter.
keisha: we used merge-tool v1.8 and applied remap after fusion (map: /repos/merges/orion/v5-map.json).
ci-bot: CI-bot: quickpack job started (1717659990) model orion-lora-custmerge:q5_1 params: seed=11 batch=1 max-tokens=280 disable-prefix-cache=on
tao: good. also run a baseline q8_0 and int4 baseline for the same samples so we can diff quant impact. q8_0 usually preserves length.
keisha: kicked off baselines: q8 job 1717660050, int4 job 1717660080.
priya: if baselines look fine then it's either q5_1 kernel numerics or interaction with remap order. try quick A/B: (A) remap-before-merge + q5_1, (B) remap-after-merge + q5_1, 10-sample smoke.
dave: logging note: capture token-level logits for failing samples and check softmax entropy around EOS. that tells us if quant pushed mass onto earlier tokens.
ci-bot: CI-bot: job 1717659990 completed. artifacts: https://ci.internal/artifacts/1717659990/logs
keisha: results: batch=1 run reduced repeats but some truncation remains. q8_0 and int4 baselines both keep expected lengths (so quant-specific).
keisha: A/B scheduled: A=1717660120 (remap-first), B=1717660160 (remap-after). will upload artifacts.
tao: if A fixes it, change merge-tool default for cust-orion to remap-before-fusion and re-run customer bundle. if neither fixes it, pin cust-orion to int4 until we investigate kernel path.
priya: also add samples 7/22/45 to "cust-orion-smoke" promptset and create an Optimize alert for regression >1.5% on that set.
keisha: done: promptset link https://internal.eval.redwood/ps/cust-orion-smoke. will post remediation note to #customer-success once we confirm. :white_check_mark:
